Libranex only provides information display, workflow guidance, authorization collection and order information relay; it does not custody or execute digital asset transactions.

You confirm that the information is true, complete and verifiable, and understand that OSL may process, retain or disclose it to necessary partners under its privacy policy, terms and applicable law.
crypto.consent: I have read and agree that OSL is responsible for crypto account KYC, compliance review and asset-related services, and authorize the sharing and processing of information within the scope above.
crypto.riskConsent: I understand crypto asset volatility, wrong-network risk, irreversible transfers, custody risk and compliance restrictions, and agree that OSL must complete final review and confirmation before I use the relevant services.

crypto.success: Crypto account request submitted. Your information will be securely relayed to OSL for KYC, compliance and asset-service review.
